'''Montrose''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Overseer (Sith)|overseer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], she was part of [[Darth Marr]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with Republic forces under [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Overseer Montrose appears as a Sith Inquisitor trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
